newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Chase Perdana sells S&P Food shares.
newsitem.headline: Chase Perdana sells S&P Food shares.

text.p: Malaysia's Chase Perdana Bhd has proposed to sell a 20.56 percent stake in S&P Food Industries Bhd for 43.69 million ringgit in cash, Chase said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The stake comprises 3.31 million shares of S&P Food, Chase said in a statement released late on Thursday. The buyer of the stake is unlisted Zenpac Industries Sdn Bhd.
Chase is a construction company, while S&P makes and exports food products.
The sale will allow Chase to realise its investment in S&P Food, resulting in an extraordinary gain for the financial year ending December 31, 1997, the statement said.
Chase did not disclose the size of the gain.
After the sale, Chase will own about 7.39 percent of S&P Food.
